description: Main entry point for a Flutter app implementing a simple Todo frontend. Sets up environment variables, app theme, and top-level widget with provider for state management.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter app, provides theme and navigation to the To-Do screen.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes environment variables and starts the Flutter app with 'TodoApp'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including theme and provider setup, and the home screen.
